capabilities: match selected prose to Bible verses
resolve ambiguous matches with a numbered picker
search a locally cached translation index
configure a custom search API backend
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; downloads a translation index (complete.simple.json) on first use and builds a local search index beside the plugin.
motivation: The README frames the pain of switching apps and losing your train of thought when looking up scripture while writing.
problem: Looking up scripture references while writing means switching apps, searching, copying and formatting, which breaks the writing flow.

relations.evidence: Reads bible-verse translation setting — picks up the defaultTranslation from the companion plugin automatically

summary: Scripture matcher that searches highlighted prose against a local Bible index and inserts a formatted ```bible citation block.
